cmd: R=/opt/weather-pipeline/repo; echo SYNC; git -C $R log -1 --format="%h %cd" --date=iso; grep -c hydrogen $R/scripts/generate_ai_analysis.py; echo HYD_ANALYSIS; grep -n "GEMINI_MODEL_CHAIN = " -A4 $R/scripts/generate_ai_analysis.py | head -8; echo LOGSTRUCT; L=/var/log/vps-ai-pipeline.log; tail -c 400000 $L | awk '/^\[?20[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9][ T][0-9:]+/ {ts=substr($0,1,22)} /AI-Gemini\] (gemini-[0-9a-z.-]+) попытка/ {print ts " | " substr($0,1,90)}' | grep "2026-11-27" | tail -40; echo SCHED; cat $R/data/ai_schedule_gemini.json | head -c 600; echo; date; echo LOG2_DONE
